 October 23, 2026: I added new Halloween Roll a Stickman codes to our list.
 Roll a Stickman codes generously award players with a range of rewards, and you'll need each and every one of them to build the best stickman army possible and progress through various bases.
As you work your way through each Roll a Stickman base, you'll need increasingly powerful stickmen to take down the resident bosses, so the combination of potions, rolls, trait rerolls, and stat rerolls available from these promos will be essential. Meanwhile, you can look forward to the odd Base Key, which can be used to unlock new background stats in the Roblox simulation game, no matter who's fighting on your side.
 If you're after some more general avatar rewards to use in all of your experiences, then we've got the current Roblox promo codes covered too. 
 All Roll a Stickman codes 
 (Image credit: Ultrain Studios) These are the Roll a Stickman codes you can redeem right now: 
 DUNGEON - 4x Dungeon Tickets new! 
 HALLOWEEN - 5x Pumpkin Eggs new! 
 6KLIKES - Instant rolls, 21x Potions, 6x Crates, 25x Card Tomes, 20x Trait Rerolls, 4x Base Keys, 1x Stat Reset, 1x Grow Potion (stage 100 required) 
 GEMSFORDAYS - 50x Gems
 3KLIKES - 17,000x Instant Rolls, 6x Crates, 6x Luck Potion, 5x Haste Potion, 5x Gilded Potion, 5x War Potion, 20x Trait Rerolls, 25x Card Tomes, 4x Base Keys, 50x Gems, 1x Stat Reset
 1KLIKES - 14,000x Instant Rolls, 6x Crates, 6x Luck Potion, 5x Haste Potion, 5x Gilded Potion, 5x War Potion, 20x Trait Rerolls, 25x Card Tomes, 4x Base Keys, 50x Gems, 1x Stat Reset
 500LIKES - 12,000x Instant Rolls, 6x Crates, 6x Luck Potion, 5x Haste Potion, 5x Gilded Potion, 5x War Potion, 20x Trait Rerolls, 25x Card Tomes, 4x Base Keys, 50x Gems, 2x Stat Reset
 200LIKES - 9,100x Instant Rolls, 4x Crates, 5x Luck Potion, 4x Haste Potion, 4x Gilded Potion, 4x War Potion, 15x Trait Rerolls, 20x Card Tomes, 3x Base Keys, 1x Stat Reset (stage 100 required) 
 50LIKES - 3,600x Instant Rolls, 3x Crates, 4x Luck Potion, 3x Haste Potion, 3x Gilded Potion, 3x War Potion, 12x Trait Rerolls, 15x Card Tomes, 2x Base Keys, 1x Stat Reset
 20LIKES - 2,200x Instant Rolls, 2x Crates, 3x Luck Potion, 2x Haste Potion, 2x Gilded Potion, 2x War Potion, 8x Trait Rerolls, 12 Card Tomes, 1x Base Key
 GRINDER - 3,300x Instant Rolls, 3x Crates, 4x Luck Potion, 3x Haste Potion, 2x Gilded Potion, 3x War Potion, 10x Trait Rerolls, 15x Card Tomes, 2x Base Keys (10,000 rolls required) 
 RANKED - 1,400x Instant Rolls, 2x Crates, 3x Luck Potion, 2x Haste Potion, 1x Gilded Potion, 2x War Potion, 5x Trait Rerolls, 10x Card Tomes
 BREW - 180x Instant Rolls, 3x Luck Potions, 2x Haste Potions, 1x Gilded Potion
 RELEASE - 1,100x Instant Rolls, 1x Crate, 2x Luck Potion, 1x Haste Potion, 2x Trait Reroll, 5x Card Tomes
 As you can see from the list above, there are plenty of Roll a Stickman codes available, and tons of rewards with them. You'll have to roll for a long time to get through all of the instant rolls available through redeeming these promos, and those crates will fill your stickman inventory out even further.
Roll a Stickman codes aren't case-sensitive, so you only have to ensure you get the spelling right, but you can always just copy and paste from above to be sure.
 Latest Videos From GamesRadar+ Watch full video here: How to redeem Roll a Stickman codes 
 (Image credit: Ultrain Studios) To redeem Roll a Stickman codes, first navigate to the menu button in the top right-hand corner of the screen before clicking on the Codes button at the bottom of the drop-down that appears. Next, enter a code from above into the box and hit Redeem .
 At this point, your codes will be sent to your mailbox, so you can collect your rewards whenever you're ready. To find them, click on the envelope button at the top of the screen. You'll need to both Open your mail and Claim you rewards.

 You must also join the Ultrain Studios Roblox group before you can enter any codes, and you'll need to close the game to do this.
 Expired Roll a Stickman codes 
 There are no expired codes. 
 Since Roll a Stickman is still relatively new, there are currently no expired codes, so you can currently claim every reward available. I don't expect that to last forever, though, so do redeem them as soon as possible.

She then honed her guides writing skills at PCGamesN between 2022 and 2026, when she took those skills to GamesRadar as a Guides Writer. Danielle's guides are a safe space - she definitely got stuck before you did, which is why she's perfect for the job. When she's not replaying the Silent Hill games or a more up-to-date single-player horror game, you'll find her fighting for her life in Dead by Daylight, tending to a garden in Stardew Valley, or doing both in Minecraft.
